in_marathi.name: Dhiman
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhiman हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhiman is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word ‘dhiti’, meaning 'memory'. It is also associated with intelligence and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Dhiman is the name of a sage who was blessed with divine knowledge and the power to remember past, present, and future.
